scenario.title: HPOS Admin Order Search: Broad Non-ID Term
scenario.trigger: Broad admin order search term that forces HPOS search across orders, order addresses, order meta, and line item tables.

slow_queries.sql: SELECT wp_wc_orders.id FROM wp_wc_orders WHERE 1=1 AND (wp_wc_orders.status IN ('wc-pending','wc-processing','wc-on-hold','wc-completed','wc-cancelled','wc-refunded','wc-failed')) AND (wp_wc_orders.type = 'shop_order') AND ( ( `wp_wc_orders`.transaction_id LIKE '%admin-order-search-needle%' OR `wp_wc_orders`.billing_email LIKE 'admin-order-search-needle%' OR `wp_wc_orders`.id IN ( SELECT search_query_meta.order_id FROM wp_wc_orders_meta as search_query_meta WHERE search_query_meta.meta_key IN ( '_billing_address_index','_shipping_address_index' ) AND search_query_meta.meta_value LIKE '%admin-order-search-needle%' GROUP BY search_query_meta.order_id ) OR wp_wc_orders.id in ( SELECT order_id FROM wp_woocommerce_order_items search_query_items WHERE search_query_items.order_item_name LIKE '%admin-order-search-needle%' ) ) ) GROUP BY wp_wc_orders.id ORDER BY wp_wc_orders.date_created_gmt
